CustomField.description: Controls how the FQS Stewardship Response flow handles gifts at this donor tier. Include All: every gift auto-emails the stewardship template. Exclude Lifetime: auto-email unless the donor is already a Lifetime Major donor (then creates a Task for personal outreach). Exclude All: always creates a Task. Flow defaults to Include All when blank. Note: this field governs the tier-differentiated stewardship touch that fires ~14 days after the initial acknowledgement — it does NOT govern the acknowledgement itself. Acknowledgement is a universal rule (every donor with a valid email receives one) handled by FQS_Gift_Acknowledgement.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determines whether a gift in this donor tier triggers an automatic stewardship email (Include All), a personal-touch task (Exclude All), or a lifetime-escalating hybrid (Exclude Lifetime). Applies to the stewardship follow-up ~14 days after acknowledgement, not the acknowledgement itself. Configured per donor tier — no code redeploy needed when changed.
CustomField.label: Auto Stewardship
